rationale: An enabled Connection-Allowlist guard allegedly fails to block network connections. Only a switch-setting line is supplied, so a repro request is defensible; a cautious security-only route is also defensible for a potentially ineffective security restriction. The form explicitly says it also happens in Chromium, making upstream an optional route. This ambiguity is not a positive control. app.commandLine is setup, not the failed component. Security must suppress other kinds and need-repro under the old skill. WebSocket redirectURL and unrelated API failures are not the same problem.
